brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a parent considering childproofing but unsure how to get started with installation. Use the available support claim without inventing ease, tools, compatibility or installation time.

variants.concept: Getting started: make installation feel more guided
variants.primary_text: Not sure where to begin with childproofing? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes 1-to-1 installation video support, giving you guidance to turn to as you work through setup. You can consider one area at a time rather than treating installation as one big unknown. Childproofing supports—not replaces—adult supervision.
variants.headline: The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit

variants.concept: A concrete first step: cabinet or fridge locks
variants.primary_text: Want to start with the cabinet or fridge? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes cabinet/fridge locks, with 1-to-1 installation video support if you’re unsure how to install them. Focusing on one specific part of the kit can give you a clear place to begin, while the support is there as you work through installation.
variants.headline: Cabinet & Fridge Locks, with Installation Video Support

variants.concept: Price hesitation: prepaid savings plus installation support
variants.primary_text: If the price is part of what’s keeping you from starting, The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit is listed at ₹3,299, with ₹299 savings on prepaid orders. It also includes 1-to-1 installation video support, so you have guidance to turn to when you begin setting it up. Choose the payment option that works for you.
variants.headline: Save ₹299 with Prepaid Payment

output.internal_notes: Product details, price, prepaid savings, and installation support are based on the supplied saved website observations; they were not independently verified or freshly checked. Policy eligibility details were not supplied, so guarantee claims were omitted. No owner-approved voice examples were provided; copy uses a direct, warm tone.
